lists.name: RYM Top — Electronic — Electronic Dance Music

podcast.body: This was the band's first album, made exclusively by Liam Howlett, and was deeply rooted in hardcore techno. It was one of the very few, possibly the only, fast hardcore techno albums to achieve mainstream success and album sales, as most hardcore techno was single-driven. It sold millions of copies and was highly successful in European capitals where hardcore techno was established, such as the Netherlands, Berlin, and London, and to some extent Paris. It offered a slightly softened, more sample-heavy, and less aggressive version of fast hardcore techno, but was largely ignored or dismissed by electronic music critics who preferred more "intellectual" IDM, considering it sacrilegious. "It sold millions of copies and gave us an idea of what such fast hardcore techno could become if it wasn't so aggressive and was more focused on sampling."
